parts.title: Listening Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Tasha talking to a friend about her family. What is each person's favourite thing?

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the three texts about computers and school. For each question, choose the correct answer.

persons.name: Berta
persons.text: We use computers and other technology in almost every class at school, and everybody is given a tablet computer to use. We also do ICT every Wednesday. Nobody buys textbooks any more, but we still read books from time to time. In the future, I don't think people will have to go to school. We'll have all our lessons online at home and that will give us more time to do sport with our friends.

persons.name: Elif
persons.text: We aren't taught ICT at our school. If we need to use the internet, the teacher takes us to the computer room, but we mostly use books in class. I don't mind that because I don't really like spending my time on computers or things like that. I prefer to finish my homework quickly and then go out skating with my friends. I'm sure that in the future people will use computers to study even more than now.

persons.name: Gloria
persons.text: We don't study ICT as a school subject because it's part of every class and we can go online in all the classrooms. I often use the internet to do my homework, too. My mum says we never use our school books but this isn't true. It's just that we use technology, too. I think the lessons of the future will be online, without books. But I hope we still go to school, because I might miss my friends if I have to study alone at home.

items.question: Who studies ICT as a school subject?
Who never uses school books during lessons?
Who does a sport with friends after school?
Who says schools won't use books in the future?
Who has to go to another classroom to go online?
Who likes studying with other people?

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 5
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.
parts.passage:
To: Lisa

I think I've lost (0) ___my___ phone.

I (1) .......... given it as a present just (2) .......... few weeks ago. I know I had it on Saturday before we went to the cinema with Jason. Have (3) .......... seen it anywhere, Lisa? It's got a green case which says 'Made (4) .......... Portugal' on it.

To: Baha

Don't worry! Theo (5) .......... got it. He found it in his dad's car after they took us home. I'm going to meet Theo later. Shall I get the phone from him? Then I can bring it (6) .......... we see each other tomorrow. Is that OK?

items.sentence: I (1) .......... given it as a present just a few weeks ago.
I was given it as a present just (2) .......... few weeks ago.
It's got a green case which says 'Made (4) .......... Portugal' on it.
Then I can bring it (6) .......... we see each other tomorrow.
